'''RefDiff''' (''The Ref-Differentiator'') is a [[Wikipedia:User scripts|user script]] and gadget for MediaWiki's diff view ({{mono|Special:Diff}}). It virtually decouples inline citation templates from sentences in Wikipedia's native diff table, eliminating '''"template camouflage"''' so reviewers and vandalism patrollers can focus on what actually changed in the prose.

== The Problem: Template Camouflage ==

Over 90% of quality control, vandalism patrolling, and editorial review on Wikipedia happens in the diff view ({{mono|Special:Diff}}).

When an article uses standard inline citations ({{tag|ref|content={{tlx|cite book |author&#61;... |title&#61;...}}}}), references often contain 300 to 600 characters of bibliographic parameters. When an editor edits a single word in a sentence, standard MediaWiki diffs ({{mono|wikidiff2}}) highlight the entire paragraph as modified:

<div style="background: #f8f9fa; border: 1px solid #c8ccd1; padding: 12px; margin: 1em 0; font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.9em; line-height: 1.5; color: #202122;">
'''Line 42:'''<br />
<span style="background: #ffe6e6; color: #7a0000; text-decoration: line-through;">− The atmosphere consists mostly of carbon dioxide&lt;ref&gt;{{tlx|Cite book |author&#61;Schmidt, Rainer |title&#61;Planetary Atmospheres |year&#61;2020 |pages&#61;112–115 |isbn&#61;978-3-12-345678-9}}&lt;/ref&gt;, creating an <span style="background: #ffb3b3; font-weight: bold;">extreme</span> greenhouse effect.</span><br />
<span style="background: #e6ffe6; color: #006600;">+ The atmosphere consists mostly of carbon dioxide&lt;ref&gt;{{tlx|Cite book |author&#61;Schmidt, Rainer |title&#61;Planetary Atmospheres |year&#61;2020 |pages&#61;112–115 |isbn&#61;978-3-12-345678-9}}&lt;/ref&gt;, creating a <span style="background: #a3f0a3; font-weight: bold;">runaway</span> greenhouse effect.</span>
</div>

=== Why this is harmful: ===
# '''Camouflaged Vandalism:''' Subtle vandalism (changing numbers, swapping years, altering names) hides inside the visual noise of untouched template parameters.
# '''Misleading Diffs on Citation Fixes:''' Updating a dead URL or correcting a page number marks the entire surrounding paragraph as modified, misleading patrollers into thinking text was rewritten.
# '''Reviewer Fatigue:''' Patrollers waste significant cognitive energy mentally filtering template syntax.

== How RefDiff Works ==

RefDiff runs client-side in the browser and transforms the diff table in-place:

# '''Zero Loss:''' Preserves 100% of Wikipedia's native diff table (line numbers, revision headers, context rows, and the native {{mono|Inline}} checkbox).
# '''Clean Prose Diffs:''' Inline {{tag|ref}} tags are replaced with clean, unobtrusive mathematical angle-bracket badges (e.g. {{mono|⟨ref1⟩}} or {{mono|⟨~ref2~⟩}}).
# '''Dedicated Citation Rows:''' If a citation was modified, added, or removed, RefDiff inserts an isolated citation diff row directly underneath the sentence.
# '''Automatic Context Conversion:''' If an edit ''only'' touched citation metadata, the prose line automatically converts to context appearance (calm gray, no diff markers). Patrollers instantly know the text itself was not altered.

== Visual Guide & Badge Legend ==

RefDiff uses mathematical angle brackets ({{mono|⟨...⟩}}) to avoid syntactic collisions with external links ({{mono|[...]}}) and wikilinks ({{mono|[[...]]}}):

{| class="wikitable"
! Badge !! Meaning !! Appearance !! Reviewer Action
|-
| {{mono|⟨ref1⟩}}
| '''Unmodified Reference'''
| Subtle neutral gray text, normal weight
| '''Ignore:''' Identical on both sides; zero prose distraction.
|-
| {{mono|⟨~ref2~⟩}}
| '''Modified Reference'''
| Amber highlight, bold, hover tooltip
| '''Review:''' Bibliographic metadata changed; see citation row below.
|-
| {{mono|{+ ⟨ref3⟩ +}}}
| '''Added Reference'''
| Green inline insertion badge
| '''Verify:''' New source added to the claim.
|-
| {{mono|[- ⟨ref4⟩ -]}}
| '''Removed Reference'''
| Red inline deletion badge
| '''Verify:''' Source removed from the claim.
|}

=== Decoupled Diff Example ===
<div style="background: #f8f9fa; border: 1px solid #c8ccd1; padding: 12px; margin: 1em 0; font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.9em; line-height: 1.5; color: #202122;">
'''Line 42:'''<br />
&nbsp;&nbsp;The atmosphere consists mostly of carbon dioxide <span style="color: #72777d;">⟨ref1⟩</span>, creating an <span style="background: #ffe6e6; color: #7a0000; text-decoration: line-through;">extreme</span> <span style="background: #e6ffe6; color: #006600;">runaway</span> greenhouse effect.<br /><br />
&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="background: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.25); color: #9a6700; font-weight: bold; padding: 0 2px;">⟨~ref1~⟩</span> &nbsp;− &lt;ref&gt;{{tlx|Cite book |... |pages&#61;<span style="background: #ffb3b3;">112–115</span>}}&lt;/ref&gt;<br />
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;+ &lt;ref&gt;{{tlx|Cite book |... |pages&#61;<span style="background: #a3f0a3;">112–125</span>}}&lt;/ref&gt;
</div>

== Installation ==

=== Option 1: Add to your common.js (Recommended)
Add the following line to your [[Special:MyPage/common.js|common.js]] page:

<syntaxhighlight lang="javascript">
// [[File:refdiff.js]] - RefDiff: Decoupled citation diffs for Special:Diff
mw.loader.load('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/m-k/einzelnachweise@main/refdiff.js');
</syntaxhighlight>

Then bypass your browser cache ({{kbd|Ctrl}}+{{kbd|F5}} on Windows/Linux, {{kbd|Cmd}}+{{kbd|Shift}}+{{kbd|R}} on macOS).

=== Option 2: Browser Extension (Tampermonkey / Violentmonkey)
If you prefer running RefDiff across all Wikimedia projects via a browser extension:
# Open your userscript manager.
# Create a new script or install from URL using:
# {{mono|https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-k/einzelnachweise/main/refdiff.js}}
# Save and enable. It matches all Wikimedia diff URLs automatically.

== UI Controls & Mode Switching ==

=== Native OOUI Mode Switcher
On Vector 2022 and Vector legacy, RefDiff adds a button directly to Wikipedia's native diff mode selector:

{| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;"
| {{mono|[ 👁 Visual ]}} || {{mono|[ [[]] Wikitext ]}} || {{mono|'''[ ⧉ RefDiff ]'''}} || {{mono|Inline ( )}}
|}

* '''Instant Toggle:''' Click {{mono|Wikitext}} to switch back to standard Wikidiff, or click {{mono|RefDiff}} to re-apply decoupling instantly (&lt; 5ms, no page reload).
* '''Inline Diff Compatibility:''' Fully compatible with Wikipedia's native {{mono|Inline}} checkbox.
* '''Fallback Mode Bar:''' On older skins without the OOUI button container (e.g. Monobook), RefDiff displays a clean switcher bar above the diff table:
  : {{mono|Diff view: '''Decoupled (RefDiff)''' • Standard Wikidiff}}

== Themes & Skins ==

RefDiff natively supports all major Wikipedia skins and color schemes:
* '''Vector 2022:''' Full native Light Mode and Dark Mode ({{mono|skin-theme-clientpref-night}}).
* '''OS Dark Mode:''' Automatically responds to operating system dark mode settings.
* '''Vector legacy (2010), Timeless, Monobook, Minerva:''' Fully compatible.

== Relationship to Other Tools & Proposals ==

* '''Writing / Editing:''' [[User:PleaseStand/References segregator]] – complementary tool that temporarily splits citations into a secondary pane in the wikitext edit window.
* '''Reviewing / Diffs:''' '''RefDiff''' – virtually decouples citations on {{mono|Special:Diff}}.
* '''Wikitext Storage Concepts:''' Long-term architectural ideas such as section-scoped reference definitions (e.g. {{tag|references|attribs=hidden}} or {{tag|ref|attribs=hidden}}) explore bringing this same clean separation to stored wikitext itself.
